caption: The video captures a dimly lit, orange-hued miniature stop-motion scene dominated by a tall, billowing plume of pinkish-orange fibrous smoke that fills the center of the frame. A sail-backed theropod stands at the right and a plated quadruped at the left, both holding fixed positions and poses throughout. Behind the dense cloud, a central creature head with an open, toothed jaw is partially veiled. Warm red-orange lighting stays consistent across the excerpt, and the framing does not shift, indicating a static camera. The visible motion resides entirely in the plume, which rises and expands upward as wispy tendrils at its top drift and curl. The dense body of the smoke shifts continuously, so the open-mouthed head behind it remains partially visible, yet the head's own pose remains constant. The flanking dinosaur figures show no limb or body movement. The cloud continues churning throughout, the scene unchanged in composition, leaving the source of the smoke and its ultimate fate outside the cropped excerpt.
